message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "# This workflow will install Python dependencies, run tests and lint with a variety of Python versions
# For more information see: https://help.github.com/actions/language-and-framework-guides/using-python-with-github-actions

name: Python package

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
    types: [opened, reopened, edited]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.9", "3.10", "3.12"]

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v3
    - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-python@v3
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
    - name: Cache pip dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.cache/pip
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('requirements.txt') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-pip-
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        python -m pip install flake8 pytest
        if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt; fi
    - name: Lint with flake8
      run: |
        # stop the build if there are Python syntax errors or undefined names
        # flake8 . --count --select=E9,F63,F7,F82 --show-source --statistics
        flake8 . --count --max-complexity=12 --max-line-length=127 --show-source --statistics \
          --ignore=E121,E123,E126,E226,E24,E704,W503,W504,E402,F722
    - name: Test with pytest
      run: |
        pytest
",
  "rationale": "Added pip dependency caching to avoid re-downloading packages on each run. Experimental evidence (experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2) shows a 9.2% reduction in median elapsed time for a similar Python workflow. Also added workflow-level concurrency with cancel-in-progress to supersede stale runs on the same branch/PR, reducing duplicate work. This is supported by pattern P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE which estimates up to 4.1% VM time reduction on paid runners. Both changes preserve all existing test coverage and required checks.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2", "pattern:P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE", "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}

Original workflow:

```yaml
# This workflow will install Python dependencies, run tests and lint with a variety of Python versions
# For more information see: https://help.github.com/actions/language-and-framework-guides/using-python-with-github-actions

name: Python package

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
    types: [opened, reopened, edited]

jobs:
  build:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.9", "3.10", "3.12"]

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v3
    - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-python@v3
      with:
        python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        python -m pip install flake8 pytest
        if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt; fi
    - name: Lint with flake8
      run: |
        # stop the build if there are Python syntax errors or undefined names
        # flake8 . --count --select=E9,F63,F7,F82 --show-source --statistics
        flake8 . --count --max-complexity=12 --max-line-length=127 --show-source --statistics \
          --ignore=E121,E123,E126,E226,E24,E704,W503,W504,E402,F722
    - name: Test with pytest
      run: |
        pytest
```

We'll add concurrency at the top level (after `on:`). We'll add:

```yaml
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
```

This will cancel previous runs for the same workflow and branch/PR.

We'll add cache step:

```yaml
    - name: Cache pip dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.cache/pip
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('requirements.txt') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-pip-
```

Place it after setup-python and before install dependencies.
